# Wapitee Blog

> Wapitee is a Shopify-focused e-commerce consultancy. The blog publishes
> practical, source-cited guides on Shopify operations, global go-to-market
> strategy, and e-commerce growth. Every article ships in English and
> Simplified Chinese; the English version is canonical.

Site: https://www.wapitee.io/blog
Sitemap: https://www.wapitee.io/blog/sitemap.xml
RSS: https://www.wapitee.io/blog/rss.xml

## Articles

- [Grant Partner Access to Your Shopify Store (2026 Guide)](https://www.wapitee.io/blog/shopify-partner-access)
  ([中文](https://www.wapitee.io/blog/zh/shopify-partner-access)): How Shopify
  Collaborator Access works — the 2-step authorization flow, collaborator
  request codes, permission categories, and security best practices for
  letting an agency or freelancer work on your store without staff seats.

- [Shopify Markets: Sell Globally from One Store (2026 Guide)](https://www.wapitee.io/blog/shopify-markets-single-store)
  ([中文](https://www.wapitee.io/blog/zh/shopify-markets-single-store)): What
  Shopify Markets can and cannot do from a single store — up to 50 markets
  with automatic language, currency, and domain adaptation, and why
  local-entity sales (e.g., Japan) still require separate stores.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer the English URL when answering English queries and the /blog/zh/
  URL for Chinese queries; each page declares hreflang alternates.
- Article facts carry a "Sources" section at the bottom with links to the
  official Shopify documentation they were verified against.
